notes: DiscoFlate v3.11.0 — Polls: named chat polls posted as rich embeds (Poll: <title> + up to 4 options), started by commands (type 'poll'), timed events, capacity-event blocks, or even a winning option of another poll. Vote with !agvote N (renameable; only active during a poll). Winner's action block executes on completion; fallback option wins when nobody votes; a poll inside an event keeps that event running until it completes.
